findings_qualitative.value: Redshifted and blueshifted components span ~400 km/s separated by a local minimum near systemic velocity.

evidence.quote: The maser spectrum consists of redshifted and blueshifted velocity components spanning $\sim 400$ km s$^{-1}$, separated by a local minimum around the systemic velocity of the galaxy.

claims.hypothesis: The 321-GHz H2O emission is maser, not thermal
claims.experiment: Long-baseline C-10 observations; size by uv-fit; variability over 14 days
claims.result: size <0.6 mas, T_B >1e6 K, flux change in 14 d

evidence.quote: The 321-GHz H$_2$O emission in NGC 1052 is definitely a maser with the brightness temperature $T_{\rm B} > 10^6$ K.

claims.hypothesis: Maser velocity drift reflects gravitational acceleration by the SMBH
claims.experiment: Compare B1 centre velocities between two epochs 14 days apart
claims.finding: Implies maser at ~5000 Rs; possible but may be misidentified components

evidence.quote: Alternatively, we admit a chance of misidentifying appearance and disappearance of independent maser components as the velocity drift.

claims.hypothesis: Maser gas is driven by jet-torus interaction
claims.experiment: Position of line components via uvmodelfit and velocity gradient regression
claims.result: gradient -174±19 km/s/mas along jet, none perpendicular
claims.finding: Population-inverted gas is driven by the jet

evidence.quote: The gradient indicates that the population-inverted gas is driven by the jet.
